/ 808 Cowbell — two detuned square-ish oscillators
/ Real 808 cowbell: ~540Hz and ~440Hz, non-harmonic interval
/ The interval (~minor third) is what gives it that hollow metallic clang
/ Short decay for normal use — can stretch N for longer
N: 11025
T: !N
C: p2%p0
/ metallic decay — cowbell has a fast initial drop then longer tail
E: e(T*(0-15%N))
/ two oscillators at specific non-harmonic frequencies
/ 540 and 442 Hz — the slight detuning from 440 adds beating character
P: +\(N#(540*C))
Q: +\(N#(442*C))
/ approximate square wave character via odd harmonics
/ using additive: fund + 3rd + 5th (scaled down)
SP: (s P)+(s(P*3)*.33)+(s(P*5)*.2)
SQ: (s Q)+(s(Q*3)*.33)+(s(Q*5)*.2)
M: SP+SQ*.8
/ bandpass the result — cowbell has a nasal mid focus
A: 0.6 f M
Z: 0.35 f M
B: A-Z
W: w E*B
\vW
\vB
